title: Earth's Biggest Waterfall Is Underwater (2,000x Niagara)

scenes.text: The biggest waterfall on Earth is underwater.
It sits in the Denmark Strait, between Iceland and Greenland.
Cold, heavy water pours over a cliff on the seafloor.
About 3.5 million cubic meters fall every second.
That's roughly 2,000 times the flow of Niagara Falls.
And the drop is more than twice as tall as Angel Falls. You just can't see it.
